seller_or_subject: Storefront search, filter, and browse mechanisms — All {merchant}.lemonsqueezy.com pages returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch, preventing observation of any search bars, filter controls, or browse mechanisms on individual storefronts. Documentation states storefronts use "a simple and easy to use template" but this is from platform_doc (D1 territory). No evidence of search or filter functionality on individual storefronts was observed in any search snippet.
